name: Simple Three Inside Pattern EA
summary: This EA trades the Three Inside candlestick pattern (a harami continuation/reversal pattern) by detecting the formation of a three-inside bar structure and opening positions accordingly. It is a straightforward pattern-recognition EA with minimal filtering, relying primarily on the pure candlestick pattern for entry signals.
summary_zh: 该EA基于三内含K线形态（孕线延续/反转形态）进行交易，通过检测三内含柱状结构的形成来开仓。这是一个简单的形态识别EA，几乎没有额外的过滤条件，主要依赖纯K线形态作为入场信号。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于经典的三内含K线形态，即第一根为长实体K线，第二根为短实体K线且完全被第一根包含（孕线），第三根K线确认方向。入场条件为检测到看涨三内含形态时做多，检测到看跌三内含形态时做空，没有使用任何技术指标作为辅助过滤。出场条件通常依赖固定止盈止损或反向形态出现，但从代码命名来看策略较为简单，可能缺乏复杂的出场逻辑。仓位管理方面，使用固定手数或简单计算，没有根据账户波动率或ATR进行动态调整。资金管理较为基础，没有马丁格尔或网格机制，但同样缺少对最大持仓、最大回撤等风控参数的严格控制。整体策略逻辑清晰但过于单一，缺乏多维度确认和风险缓冲机制。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the classic Three Inside candlestick pattern (harami pattern), where the first bar is a long-body candle, the second bar is a short-body candle fully contained within the first (harami), and the third bar confirms the direction. Entry conditions trigger a buy when a bullish three-inside pattern is detected and a sell when a bearish three-inside pattern is detected, without any technical indicator filters for additional confirmation. Exit conditions likely rely on fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels or the appearance of a reverse pattern, but the strategy appears simplistic based on the naming convention and may lack sophisticated exit logic. Position sizing uses a fixed lot size or simple calculation, without dynamic adjustment based on account volatility or ATR. Money management is basic with no martingale or grid mechanisms, but also lacks strict controls on maximum positions, maximum drawdown, or other risk parameters. Overall the strategy logic is clear but overly one-dimensional, lacking multi-factor confirmation and risk buffering mechanisms.

parameters.description_en: EA magic number for order identification

pros: 策略逻辑简单清晰，基于经典K线形态，易于理解和验证
纯价格行为交易，不依赖滞后指标，入场相对及时
无马丁格尔或网格机制，不会因亏损加倍而爆仓
代码结构简洁，适合初学者学习和二次开发
pros_en: Strategy logic is simple and clear, based on a classic candlestick pattern, easy to understand and verify
Pure price action trading without lagging indicators, entries are relatively timely
No martingale or grid mechanism, avoiding account blow-up from doubling after losses
Clean code structure, suitable for beginners to learn and build upon
cons: 仅依赖单一K线形态，缺乏多维度确认，虚假信号较多
没有使用趋势过滤器，在震荡市和逆趋势中可能频繁亏损
缺少传播过滤和时段过滤，在低流动性时段容易被套
止盈止损为固定点数，未考虑市场波动率变化
没有动态仓位管理，无法根据账户风险自动调整手数
cons_en: Relies solely on a single candlestick pattern without multi-factor confirmation, resulting in many false signals
No trend filter, likely to suffer frequent losses in choppy or counter-trend markets
Lacks spread filter and session filter, vulnerable to being trapped in low-liquidity periods
Fixed pip-based stop-loss and take-profit without considering market volatility changes
No dynamic position sizing, unable to automatically adjust lot size based on account risk
improvements: 增加趋势过滤器（如均线方向或ADX），仅在顺势方向交易三内含形态
加入ATR动态止盈止损，根据市场波动率自适应调整出场点位
improvements_en: Add a trend filter (e.g., moving average direction or ADX) to only trade three-inside patterns in the trend direction
Implement ATR-based dynamic stop-loss and take-profit to adapt exit levels to market volatility

risk_points: 单一形态信号可靠性有限，可能在不利市场条件下产生连续亏损
固定止损未考虑波动率，在高波动时段止损可能过近导致频繁被扫
risk_points_en: Single pattern signal reliability is limited, may produce consecutive losses in unfavorable market conditions
Fixed stop-loss without volatility consideration may be too tight during high-volatility sessions, causing frequent stop-outs
